metadata.question: Did surface water extent in southern Iran increase on January 7, 2022 compared to December 14, 2021?

data.raw_code: The user wants to compare surface water extent in southern Iran between two specific dates: December 14, 2021 and January 7, 2022. For surface water detection, I should use: 1. Sentinel-1 SAR data - good for water detection as water appears dark due to low backscatter 2. JRC Global Surface Water dataset - specifically designed for water detection 3. MODIS or Landsat for optical water indices Given the specific dates and need for reliable water detection, I'll use the JRC Global Surface Water dataset which provides monthly water classification. Strategy: 1. Define southern Iran region (using a polygon) 2. Use JRC Yearly Water Classification for 2021 and 2022 3. Extract water pixels for both dates in the same region 4. Compare the water extent The JRC dataset has monthly water classification, so I can directly compare December 2021 vs January 2022. For validation: - Check if collections have data - Check if there are valid water pixels - Ensure the comparison makes sense ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions // Southern Iran region (approximate polygon) var southernIran = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [51.0, 25.0], [61.0, 25.0], [61.0, 30.0], [51.0, 30.0], [51.0, 25.0] ]); // 2. Data Acquisition - JRC Global Surface Water Monthly History var dec2021 = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_3/MonthlyHistory/2021_12') .select('water'); var jan2022 = ee.Image('JRC/GSW1_3/MonthlyHistory/2022_01') .select('water'); // Check if images exist try { var decInfo = dec2021.getInfo(); var janInfo = jan2022.getInfo(); } catch (e) { print("Error accessing JRC data"); print("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Extract water pixels (value = 2 for water) var decWater = dec2021.eq(2).selfMask(); var janWater = jan2022.eq(2).selfMask(); // 4. Calculate water extent var decStats = decWater.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: southernIran, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var janStats = janWater.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: southernIran, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var decWaterPixels = decStats.get('water').getInfo(); var janWaterPixels = janStats.get('water').getInfo(); // 5. Validation & Final Answer print("December 2021 water pixels: " + decWaterPixels); print("January 2022 water pixels: " + janWaterPixels); if (decWaterPixels === null || janWaterPixels === null) { print("C3"); } else if (decWaterPixels === 0 || janWaterPixels === 0) { print("C2"); } else if (janWaterPixels > decWaterPixels) { print("Water extent increased"); print("A"); } else { print("Water extent did not increase"); print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
